title: One ordinary transition from an input configuration
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle on Boolean input $x$, and let $c$ be a configuration. Set its state to $s$, its input-head position to $ip$, and register $r$'s head position to $p$, keeping its tape contents, other head positions, and output from $c$. If $P$ has no oracle call at $s$, then one step of its run from this configuration equals applying the machine transition prescribed by $P$ for state $s$, the input symbol at position $ip$ (with no symbol at position zero), and the scanned work-tape symbols.
hypotheses_covered: The program $P$, oracle, Boolean input $x$, and configuration $c$ are given.
The state $s$, valid input-head position $ip$, register index $r$, and integer position $p$ are given.
There is no oracle call at state $s$.
